fields.how-to: Your first strawberry is found on the second screen of the subchapter, requiring you to jump up using the spring and dash upwards to reach it. Land on the ground, and there you go!
On the third screen; you need to jump off the block at the end of the room, collect the berry, quickly dash up to avoid falling into a spike pit, and grabbing up a wall.

On the fourth screen; this is a flying strawberry. To collect it, use the disappearing platforms at the right of the screen to jump upwards towards on top, and then jump off the left side to collect the berry. An alternative speedrun-specific strategy involves the use of Wallbounces.

The room after the flying strawberry, on your left, when you find a glowing light, go left. Hidden behind a small challenge, collecting this berry involves scaling up a small ice wall with a few spikes here and there. Dashing rightwards after falling down, at the left, will net you the berry.
Boost off the zipper left-upwards, and climb onto the right side of the ice block with spikes on top. Jump off upwards, and dash left-upright to collect the strawberry.

In the same room as strawberry 5, instead of heading upwards using the spring, which is how you would normally progress, head downwards, leaning on the right wall. An ice block can be seen: dash on it to destroy the block. In the room that follows, jump downwards, dash onto and hold the zipper, and jump onto it as it stops; subsequently jump to where the strawberry is. Jump off leftwards and dash up-left, through the floor, to get back to safety.

To reach this berry, instead of going to the right in the first room of crossing, go left into the room, and then dash into the dash refill and dash again, then climb up to the next screen. Jump over the first spring and jump on the second one, grab the wall and then jump above it, dash diagonally in the upper left corner into the refill and repeat the dash. You can also find Theo right after the berry or when going left instead of up.

At the start of Crossing, go on the higher platform, jump and dash diagonally in the upper right corner, collecting the refill and again dashing to the right, then instead of going up dash into the first block under the exit of the screen, which makes an exit appear in a small hidden path with the berry.

In the third room of Crossing, the one with two zippers (one heading right straight into spikes, and the other heading upwards), use the first zipper normally, jump onto the second one, and boost up-leftwards to where an "up arrow" sign can be seen. From there, head left, and continue through another (relatively harder) room with two zippers. Once you're outside of the city, and can hear the "Piano Only" version of First Steps, jump and dash left until you find the satellite, collecting the strawberry on your way. Don't forget to collect the Crystal Heart while you're here!

In the fourth room of the sub-chapter, go up with the spring and dash into the block of ice, revealing a small room, dash diagonally in the upper left corner three times, grab the berry, walljump into the refill, diagonally dash in the upper right corner into the refill and do the same again.

Reach the room mentioned above in Strawberry 10, but instead of heading back after getting the berry, climb up on a floating block and then dash into an odd-looking tile on the ceiling, leading you to a secret room. After beating it you will enter another room, where you can find the berry and go back to the main trial.

In the seventh room after the checkpoint, you can find a small hole in the ground, which you can dash into instead of dashing onto the crumbling blocks; in the room you just entered jump on the 3 zipper blocks, grab the berry and wait a bit on the wall for the traffic light blocks to come back to their original position and come back to the entrance.

The strawberry is located again in room 7, but this time, instead of going to the right to leave the room, go up and find another section with the berry, grab the zipper block and climb onto the wall. If you jump off the traffic light block, you will immediately get launched into spikes; jump on the other, smaller zipper, when it reaches its leftmost point, jump off of it, grab the wall and walljump off of it to get the berry.

In the eighth room, jump on the edge of the first zipper and use the boost from jumping off of it while it's going up to jump between the spikes surrounding the berry and if necessary dash up to grab it.

In the ninth and final room of Crossing, to reach the berry you can jump off a 2-tile wide platform, dash up to grab the zipper from the right side, when the zipper is on the right side jump off of it to quickly grab the berry, jump on the zipper and then jump up

At the first room of Chasm, go left by grabbing the zipper and jump dash over it. Go into the room and go the down path by dashing over the zipper. Then, go on the spring in the next room and jump on it, then quickly jump down on the platform and go up. When outside, just jump down and dash back up after walljumping. Then just go back right by jumping down to the platform and dashing to the spring and dashing after the spike platform.
Follow the same path as for the previous berry but go up from the first room instead of left. Dash up into the traffic light block and launch yourself into the strawberry.
Found in the first room, you need to fall off of the right bridge and move right to then dash straight up, allowing you to reach the strawberry.

Found to the right of the first room is another winged strawberry. Ride the traffic light block and jump off it once it reaches its furthest point to either land on the disappearing platform or grab the right wall. You can just go left after reaching the platform and bounce off the spring and into the reach of the winged strawberry.

In the fourth room, you can find a transition in the top-left by going through the wall behind a falling platform. In the room with the Strawberry, dash into the dash crystal above you and continue dashing into the other dash crystals all around the platform, grabbing the berry on the left and then continuing back right.

This strawberry is found in the same room as the mirror, but out of view without the use of binoculars. To reach it, you need to stay on the falling platform in the previous room and then go right into a hidden gap which allows you to grab the berry.

In the eighth room (to the top-left of the mirror room), this strawberry can be found in a hidden area above the middle of the 3 dream blocks, which you can dash upward through said dream block to reach.

This will be the first seeded strawberry of the game. To collect these berries, do not touch the floor before collecting all of the strawberry seeds. The room where it's found is a tall room accessed from the upper two left transitions in the fourth room. Keep yourself airborne by dashing into any nearby dream blocks as they move and you can get all the seeds.

In a room below the previous berry's room (past a smashable wall on the floor), or from the bottom left transition in the fourth room, this strawberry will be simple if approached from the former route. It is possible to get the distance to grab this berry from below, but you should be smashing the floor in the room above to access it with no challenge.

In the fourth room, this strawberry must be carefully approached. It is hovering in the upper area surrounded by many spikes. To collect it, position yourself to diagonally dash downward into the area it's in, then either quickly dash straight upward or grab the wall, then dash straight upward to be in the safety to collect the strawberry.

By going to the transition right of where the previous berry is located, the 6th berry is seen. Dash upward diagonally to land yourself on the traffic light block and then dash directly right so you'll be stopped while the traffic light block is also stopped on the right. Dash from there to the strawberry and climb up to safety.

To the room right of the previous berry's room is where this strawberry is found. The safest approach is to dash right after jumping into the dream block, then dashing diagonally upward into the next and then grabbing the wall. After collecting the strawberry, climb higher and then dash left twice through the dream blocks to make it back.

Hidden in the floor of berry 6's room is a transition. Line yourself up with the hole and dash straight down to get in. This will take you to a hidden tunnel above a previous room which contains this strawberry.

This strawberry is found by backtracking to the second room and going straight up the dream block to then go right and arrive above the third room. To collect the berry, dash directly right into the upper dream block and then the lower one. Climb up to get the berry, then dash left twice and climb the wall as you return to claim the strawberry.

In the second room, this strawberry forces you to detour from the exit by going up-right from the dream block. For the most consistent collect, dash right into the berry, climb up and wait a bit, then jump back left.

In the third room, you can see this strawberry inside a wall but with no real way to get it. In order to reach this area, dash straight left from the right side of the dream block just above the spikes. To make sure Badeline doesn't hit you, grab the berry and cling to the right wall, then dash to the left wall when she approaches and escape like normal.
In the sixth room, the berry is located in the top-left corner. Dash up one side of the wall, jump to the other side and grab the strawberry, and slide down the wall.

From the seventh room, you can notice an opening in the ceiling between 2 walls filled with spikes. Try to get yourself under the second dream block in the room, then dash straight up and move left a bit before dashing straight up again. From there you can get into the room above and collect this strawberry.

In the seventh room, this strawberry is very tricky to get because you can't interact with the falling platform above it or else it will block off the berry or crush you. Try your best to grab onto the walls elevated above spikes and climb them to jump into the pit with the berry, then quickly dash out and finish the room.

In the eighth room, you can approach this berry differently depending on if you take the shortcut mentioned earlier. If you do take this shortcut, simply move right from your fall and into the hole where this strawberry is floating to collect it. If you don't, it's still possible to get this strawberry. When you approach the large, square-shaped dream block, dash through it diagonally up-right and then dash straight up to reach the berry.

From the eleventh room, you can access a screen transition at the top in the same column as the fourth dream block from the left. In the room above, dash straight up to find the strawberry and move left and right, dashing through the dream block as you descend, to avoid your death.

From the eleventh room, another screen transition can be found in the same column as the fourth dream block from the right. It's at the bottom, so to enter it you just have to dash straight down from the top of the dream block. In the room below, you can make it to the strawberry by dashing diagonally up-right from below both dream blocks. Once you get to the berry, do the same but mirrored to return.

In the sixth room, the hole in the ceiling still exists and can be entered. Another room must be scaled and then is a room with the winged strawberry. Jump onto the left spring and then move right in the air and jump across the disappearing platforms to the other spring. Climb the right wall after bouncing on this spring and jump left on the other disappearing platforms. To reach the winged strawberry, you actually need to dash into it. Aim for slightly higher than where the berry hovers as it will start flying up when you dash. Category:Chapters' collectables

This strawberry floats low in the air below the second moving dust bunny. Stay bouncing on the spring until the moving dust bunny is at its highest, then move right and grab the wall after grabbing the berry and climb up.

In the third room, this berry is only accessible by exploiting screen transitions. At the end of the room, go back left over the roof and back at the left you can see the strawberry hovering around spikes. Dash diagonally back and forth through this room and the one to the left to reach the platform. Walk off the platform to hit the strawberry then dash left.

In the sixth room, this strawberry is floating near a cluster of dust bunnies. Stand on the fourth floating platform (at the top-left of the dust bunnies) and walk off to the right when the circling dust bunny moves past the bottom-right of Madeline, then dash straight left to land on the green platform.

A hidden area can be found by walking through the bottom-left of the eighth room (which has the second key). In the room you arrive in, walk into the spring on the floor and grab onto the falling platform. When this platform starts falling, jump and grab the next falling platform, then do it again for the last one. Dash left after this third platform started to fall. This strawberry is in the room to the left. Jump left when the moving dust bunny on the right is moving up, wait a bit, then jump left again and dash directly left without touching the disappearing platform. Then, jump off the wall after claiming the strawberry and you can make it back by jumping and dashing.

To get to this berry, follow the same route as the previous berry. A smashable wall is on the ceiling of the room where the 4th berry is located in, so dash into this ceiling to continue. In the next room, jump and dash straight left to get past the narrow gap with the dust bunnies. Touch the dash crystal and make your way up the corridor, then dash to the left at the top and slide down the left wall, jumping before you land in the dust bunnies, and do the same for the wall you land at. After transitioning from a previous room, complete another room. Dash directly into both dash crystals and wait before dashing the last time underneath the floating dust bunny. After this, go left to find the strawberry on a balcony over a previous room.

In the ninth room, a vertical transition is to the top-left of where Mr. Oshiro is waiting. Wait on the last sinking platform to jump to the floating platform furthest to the right, then climb up and jump off the right side and dash diagonally upward to the right to climb the corridor. In this room above, the strategy is just dashing directly into every dash crystal. Slide down the right wall to grab the strawberry and jump off the wall, then dash left to get back to safety.

A winged strawberry is at the end of the eleventh room. Climb the first platform and jump over to get to the next one. Jump to the third platform to climb up and jump over it, then stick to the right side of the fourth platform and jump off. From there, grab the berry.

In the fourteenth room, this strawberry is floating underneath the leftmost sinking platform. Aim to run off the platform while both circling dust bunnies are far away and grab the wall until you're comfortable dashing out of the pit to climb to safety.

In the fifteenth room, a hidden path is above where you start. Upon entering the room, first walk into the hole and dash to the left to land on the platform. Go right, dash left again, and slide down the wall to then jump off and land on a lower platform. Jump into the gap in-between the dust bunnies and dash left, then you can reach the strawberry. To get out of the area, start climbing the left wall and dash to any nearby disappearing platform to refresh your stamina when needed.

This strawberry is floating at the top over spikes. From the start of the room, jump across the first set of dust bunnies and climb the wall you reach. Jump off this wall and dash over the next wall to reach the next platform. Jump to the floating platform and then jump at the top to the other side, then wall jump to the other floating platform. Then, jump to the platform that the berry is hovering over, then jump up and dash to the left. To survive, wall jump off the right side of the very first wall you climbed over and climb up right left side of the wall opposite of it. To continue the room without dying, do a wall jump off the left and dash diagonally up-right to grab the rightmost floating platform, then jump over to move on.

On the right side of the fifteenth room, a smashable wall is located on the floor. This will take you to a spot above a previous room with two moving dust bunnies in a narrow corridor. Start running right as soon as the dust bunny on the floor starts moving right, then shortly after jump and dash right to reach the berry. Standing on the elevated floor where the strawberry resided, dash to the left as soon as the moving dust bunny on the floor starts moving right and continue left quickly to get out.

The third room of the green path will have this strawberry hovering near dust bunnies and moving dust bunnies. Walk off the ledge while the dust bunny on the right is also going down, and touch the strawberry. Then, quickly dash diagonally up-right and jump off the right wall to cling onto the floating platform. Do a jump straight up and either walljump off the upper area on the right or climb up it to get to safety.

This berry is located in the fifth room of the green path at the bottom-right. To get it, slide down the wall and dash to the right to grab the floating platform. Climb up and jump over the top of the platform to get the strawberry and then start climbing up the right side of the platform jump over it again and, when your hitbox is inside the dash crystal, dash straight to the left and then dash left again. Finish the room normally to claim the berry.

This winged strawberry is protected by dust bunnies in the third room of the purple path. To get to this berry, jump onto each pillar when the dust bunny is moving up and hold onto the sides until the next one does the same (if clutter remains, you can stand on it instead of clinging to the wall). Dash at the end to cause the winged strawberry to fly up, then jump into it to grab it.
In the fifth room of the purple path is a strawberry hiding behind some foreground water. Walk off the right side of the floating platform, dash directly left, and climb up to finish the room.

A right transition is in the second (third if counting the room shared with the platform-rearranging button's room) room of the brown path. In the room you enter is the strawberry surrounded by trigger spikes. Climb the first pillar of boxes and dash right after jumping from the apex of your climb to land on another set of boxes. Jump and dash from there to the right again, then climb the right wall to collect the berry. When you fall below the set of boxes to the left of the berry, dash directly left to land on the part of the previously stepped-on set of boxes. Jump left to the first set of boxes and dash left over the dust bunnies at the beginning to claim the strawberry.

In the fifth room of the brown path, the path to the strawberry is on the left. Walljump up the first section while dodging moving dust bunnies and dash diagonally up-left to avoid touching as many dust bunny-spawning tiles as possible. Wall jump up the second section to grab the strawberry, then dash to the right or up-right when falling back down. Then, safely exit the first section and go through the door.

After pressing any clutter switch, return to the first room. Then, you can go below where the bridge was originally covered and find a room with a strawberry. Avoid the water, as dust bunnies are there.

First, try to land at the furthest right possible area on the first platform elevated over the dust bunnies, and don't move. Jump up and dash left without any motion inputs. Next, jump to the left and dash straight up to grab the lower ledge. Jump up from there and land on the right side of the ledge. Then, jump left, dash directly upward, and steer yourself right to land on the right section of the upper ledge. From here, dash right into the berry and land in the lower area where you didn't already stand. Walk to the left, jumping over the dust bunnies you spawned earlier, and, from there, jump left and dash straight up to land on the left side of the lower ledge. Do this again to land on the left side of the upper ledge. Finally, finish the room like normal.

This strawberry is in the room below the cutscene with Oshiro. Walk off the platform right as the moving dust bunny at the bottom reaches the right. Dash to the right to land as far on the platform as possible. Jump to the wall and climb up it, then jump off and dash straight up to grab the berry and then hold onto the wall again. Climb up a bit and then, when the moving dust bunny reaches the right, jump to the platform to make it past the dust bunnies you previously spawned. Finish the room like normal to claim the berry.

At the start of the long horizontal room containing the key is a gap in the floor. By going down it, a room containing two strawberries can be entered. On the right area, hold onto the wall just under where the moving dust bunnies are going back and forth. When the one in the middle moves to the left, dash directly upward, then move to the right and fall into the gap between two moving dust bunnies. Jump from this wall on the left to the right and collect the dash crystal, then jump back to the left side and climb up the wall. Repeat the first step but mirrored to get to safety and claim this strawberry.

In the same room as the previous berry, this one hides behind a cloth on the left. To enter the area, hold onto the left wall and dash up just as the middle dust bunnies move to the right. Then, move left to land on the floor below. Jump and dash up when the moving dust bunny guarding the strawberry is moving away to grab the berry, then fall back down and land on the lower floor without touching the dust bunnies you spawned earlier. Exit the area by repeating the process of entering but mirrored.

In the fifth room, this strawberry requires you to bounce on Oshiro's head to reach it. It's located around a tunnel of dust bunnies and is out of reach without the extra boost. Stand on the right edge of the platform to the left of it and wait until Oshiro's laser shoots out, jump and dash up-right, and fall through the tunnel to get the berry safely.

A strawberry is near the start in a tight corridor between dust bunnies. Dash up from the floor, jump across, and grab the berry without touching the dust bunnies. Another method is to bounce on Oshiro's head to get on the wall with a dash. From there, dash through where the berry is to get it.

Around the middle of the ninth room is a strawberry floating at the bottom. Walk off the left edge, dash to the right, and climb the wall to get it. Be sure that Oshiro won't attack you during this time by letting him pass before you walk off. Category:Chapters' collectables Category:Celestial Resort
Found in the third room, this strawberry is hidden inside a wall. Climb and dash up above the left side of the room and in the gap opposite the wall where the bird is resting.

Found in the fourth room, the berry is seen floating near the bottom of the screen near a wall. Jump up the ledge nearby and fall to get the strawberry, then jump off the wall and dash straight up to get back on the ledge.

Found in the fifth room, this strawberry is between spikes. To collect the berry, direct the green bubble under it up and climb the smashable wall to then dash straight up to reach it, then finish the room normally.
This strawberry can be found at the end of the sixth room under a ledge. Jump off the left wall to bounce on the cloud and reach the berry, then move back to the left and bounce back to safety.

Found in the eighth room, this berry seems tricky to get as going towards it puts you against the wind. Fall down the corridor in the middle and dash left to get to the strawberry. Wall jump off the wall that the berry was next to and use your jumps and climbs carefully to not run out of stamina as you get back up.
In the ninth room, a smashable wall is seen. Jump left into it and dash straight up to find the strawberry.

By going left in the tenth room (before the Cassette room), a room with a seeded strawberry is reached. After collecting one strawberry Seed, wind starts blowing left. First, grab the rightmost seed, jump off the right wall, dash diagonally up-left, and land on the spring. Bounce up and dash straight up for the next seed, then climb the platform floating left off the spring and jump carefully over it to collect the third seed to the bottom-left of it before dashing diagonally again. Using the wind to push you left, jump up the left corridor off the wall to reach the last seed.

Found in the eleventh room, this strawberry is floating by a platform far away from the main wall. When the wind starts blowing, jump up the right wall as much as possible, then dash to the right side of the floating platform and jump above it to grab the berry just as the wind starts blowing again, then pull yourself right as soon as possible.

By going right out of the first room, you can arrive at a room with two strawberries. This first berry is in the open at the right side of the room. Ride the guided platform straight to the right and dash above the spikes to reach the strawberry. Leave the room by riding the lower guided platform back left.

In the same room as the previous berry is a smashable wall in the top-right corner. After reaching the right side with the guided platform used previously, fall to the lower guided platform and jump to the right wall, climb it, and dash straight up to break the smashable wall. Hold onto the wall until the guided platform respawns, jump to it, then finish the room.

Above the guided platform, go to the right. In this room, bounce in the spring and dash to the triggered platform, then, as it goes down, jump over it to the guided platform right of it. Steer this platform right, fall into the strawberry, and ride up the next triggered platform. Grab onto the triggered platform pointing left when you reach it and ride it to safety.

Go into the lowest transition on the left, this strawberry is floating in the middle. To get it, grab the left side of the triggered platform, ride it to the left, then jump off, dash straight up when the time is right, and grab the side of the triggered platform when you fall to ride to the end.

This berry will first require you to go up on the left side. To traverse this first room, first land on the guided platform and steer it up a bit such that it fits over the wall but under the small platform. Jump over the platform to land on the guided platform again, then steer it downward. Jump and dash straight up to land on the bridge and then continue left. In the following room, jump and dash to the guided platform and steer it right as it goes up. There will then be a section of green bubbles which is simple to follow, then fall down the left side. In this next room, dash into the green bubble and go right, then dash to the guided platform. Move it to the right as it goes up and then jump to the left wall at the top. Jump off this left wall when the guided platform breaks and finally get the strawberry. You can then go right through a previous berry room to make it back to the main hub.

From the very top transition of the first room, you can make it to the other side of a future room in the subchapter. In this area, bounce from the pink cloud onto the top of the nearby guided platform. Ride it left, moving it down or up accordingly when needed, and you can arrive at the left side of the room where you fall into the bottom transition and find this strawberry hovering above a previous room.
Found in the second room, this strawberry is found by going through a hidden passage through the water, where it then floats in the open.

Continuing right from the previous berry by breaking a smashable wall will take you to the Crystal Heart room. In that room, dash right through another smashable wall to make it to a room with this strawberry in it. Jump onto the first triggered platform to activate it, but make sure to jump to the triggered platform pointing upward to move it out of the way so the first triggered platform is able to keep moving. When you reach the right, dash directly upward and grab the right side of the next triggered platform. Land on this platform and carefully dash around the crystals to arrive where this berry resides at the top-left.

Found in the fifth room, this strawberry hovers over spikes at the right. First, play through this room normally to get the guided platform on course to cross paths with this berry. Hold onto the right side of the guided platform and climb up when possible, then jump to grab the berry while also landing on top of the guided platform, and move it downward to keep yourself safe to continue right and finish the room.

Above the left wall of the first room, a left transition leads to a windy room containing the first berry. Approach the winged strawberry from the left side by jumping all the way to the left and then jumping up the wall. Don't jump while holding the wall, as this wastes your stamina, and jumping normally will still give height thanks to the wind. Walljump to get above the spikes and continue jumping up the higher part of the wall. When you get to the top, jump right and dash right (above where the winged strawberry is) to reach the starting ledge, then climb it up to safety.

Found in the first room, this strawberry is floating under the main platforming area of the room near the start. Walk off the small platform above the berry and right as you touch it, start going left and dash diagonally up-left and grab the wall above the spikes. Climb up the wall and land on it to claim the berry.

Found in the fourth room, this strawberry is at the far-right side of the screen. To get this strawberry, first do the whole room normally and land on the bridge at the end. From there, wait until the triggered platform used earlier respawns, then go back down to the green bubble and direct it up-left and steer Madeline left to then grab onto the triggered platform. This will allow you to be on the platform while having a dash available. Ride it to the right side and jump to the berry to grab it, then jump back left and dash into the green bubble, allowing to claim the strawberry.

In the fifth room, an alternate path to the left can be entered which leads to this berry's room. Using the harsh wind, jump left and dash left to be barely able to reach the strawberry. Jump or climb up the left wall to reach the dash crystal, and from there jump right and diagonally dash up-right into the next dash crystal, then dash right again to enter the green bubble. Aim the green bubble directly right and then dash diagonally up-right into the last dash crystal, then fall down and dash directly right to make it back.

Found in the fifth room, this strawberry is seen at the end in a complicated area. Ride the triggered platform to the right and collect the key token while holding onto the wall. Make a jump to the left and dash at the last moment to reach the touch switch gate; climb it to get back to safety and claim the berry.

Found in the eighth room, this strawberry is found around the middle of the room floating around many crystal spikes. Take the closest green bubble directly left and let the wind blow you to the wall. Climb this wall and, when the wind stops, jump left to grab the berry and quickly dash directly right to get back to the wall. From here, climb back up, go to the green bubble, and move on like normal.

A hidden room can be found to the right of the eighth room. To access it, go through the slightly cracked part of the right wall above the spikes. The following room will have many green bubbles which you need to aim right and then dash up to advance. For the third green bubble, aim it down-right and dash up-right. Walljump up the next corridor and take the green bubbles at the top to the left to finally see the strawberry. Aim the final green bubble directly down to grab the berry, then dash to the side. Hold onto the wall and climb back up so you can walljump into the green bubble and use it to get out of the room.

There is a smashable wall found on the left of the first room. By going to the ledge opened up by breaking this smashable wall, you can get up to a hidden area in the ceiling by dashing straight up. The room accessed through this area will be a large one and very tricky to figure out. Start by jumping over the guided platform and grabbing onto its left side, then start steering it to the left as it rises. When you get to the top, jump and dash to the left and reach the green bubble. Direct the green bubble left, the dash straight up. Grab the right side of the next guided platform and move it left to take it to the top of the next area. When you reach the top, jump to the other side of the next guided platform and grab on, then direct this guided platform to the right as it rises. Jump and dash to make it to the next green bubble, direct it right, and ride up the triggered platform. When you can, let go and dash to the right.

Found in the second room, this strawberry is underneath a disappearing platform. Advance to the third disappearing platform and fall down when it disappears to touch the berry, then dash up-left to get back to safety.

Found in the fifth room, this berry is hovering over crystal spikes around the end of the room. Using the green bubble nearby, launch yourself up and then dash directly left to grab the strawberry and arrive at an earlier platform. You can claim the berry and continue the room like normal.
Found in the eighth room, you can find this strawberry inside a secret area accessed by directing the second green bubble upward.

Found in the tenth room, this strawberry is located near the end by some green bubbles. Take the second to last green bubble directly to the right and reach the berry, immediately dash straight upward into the other green bubble, then take it to the end of the room like normal. Category:Golden Ridge Category:Chapters' collectables

By going left of the first room, you can find the area seen at the end of Chapter 4 with the gondola at the ledge. Walk off this ledge and then head back right, then dash diagonally up-right to get into the suspicious hole in the mountain and an area with this strawberry.
Found in the fifth room, there is a hidden smashable wall to the left of the red bubble which you normally would use to get to the upper section. The strawberry is behind this smashable wall.

Found in the fifth room, this strawberry can be found in the top left. To get to it, first use the uppermost red bubble to go left and then grab the wall. Jump and grab the next piece of the wall on the left, then from here jump and climb the right wall. Walljump off the top and collect the berry, then fall through a gap on the left before dashing directly right to make it back to safety.

Go from the lower section of the fifth room to the bottom left to find a room with this strawberry. To make it over to the strawberry, jump onto the spring on the swap block, then dash to the left to bounce on it again before grabbing the wall and grabbing the berry. Dash diagonally up-right such that you go above where the swap block is going to arrive, then bounce on the spring. Move right to land on the spring again as it moves back right, then dash right and climb up to the starting area.

Go to the right of the room of the previous berry to find another room that contains a berry. Use the red bubble to go up, dash right at the top, take the other red bubble left, then dash directly down at the gap at the left.

Enter the bottom-right transition of the fifth room to reach a room with this berry. Jump on top of the first swap block, then for the next one dash straight up between the two swap blocks, then land below where the swap block just moved away from. Quickly dash again, make it to below the third swap block, and reach the strawberry. Dash again to move the swap block and return left with one more dash. Jump up and dash directly up in between the first and second swap block and grab onto the second one, then jump off it to the left to make it back.

Two rooms below the fifth room, this strawberry can be found floating in the top middle around many spinners. Stand on either of the swap blocks and face towards the berry. Hit dash and immediately move towards the berry and you'll be shot far past it while grabbing it in the process and landing safely.

By going to the left transition of two rooms below the fifth room, there's a room with this strawberry. First jump and dash into where the swap block will arrive, then cling onto it. Collect the dash crystal and hold onto the wall. For a consistent strategy, jump off the wall and dash directly up back into the dash crystal, then dash directly left to grab the other swap block. Jump off this one to make it to the strawberry. For a safe return back, jump to the right and just keep going right with a diagonally up-right dash to grab the ledge. Alternatively, walljump off the left swap block for more safety.

By going to the right transition of two rooms below the fifth room, there's a room with this strawberry. The first step to collecting this berry is to stand on the swap block lined up with the vertical gap between the spinners. Dash directly downward onto this swap block, then jump just after to get a huge boost upward allowing you to dash directly up into the red bubble. Take this red bubble right and dash straight down onto the strawberry and steer yourself to the left to enter another red bubble. Ride this to the right and dash down when you reach the gap to the lower area, and you can safely claim this berry.

From the sixth room, you need to go up to the top transition to find the room with this strawberry. To do this, just walljump off the left area to the dash directly up and grab the right side of the floating platform, then from there jump right onto the swap block and boost yourself up with a jump at the end of its return. In the room above, first jump and dash diagonally up-right above where the first swap block will move to, then grab its right side. Jump off into the dash crystal and grab the other swap block. Jump off of this swap block and then make a diagonally up-right dash to grab onto it on the other side of the crystal, allowing you to get to the top and collect the strawberry.

Go to the left of the eighth room by riding a red bubble left to reach another room where the berry will be floating on the left side. Jump over the swap block and grab its left side, then dash into it. At the left side, jump off the swap block, grab the strawberry, hit the dash crystal, then dash right and grab the swap block to go back.

In the ninth room, there's a hidden area found inside the central platform. Notice the chunk of the platform which is dented inward and dash directly up from the red bubble after riding it to the left a bit. In this area is a dash switch that unlocks a temple gate in a hidden lower area of the room. Hit this dash switch then finish the room like normal. Ride the red bubble in the following room to the right, then up. There will be a couple of touch switches to collect in the next room unlocking a temple gate guarding the berry. For the left key token, ride the bottom red bubble up, then dash out to enter the second red bubble and aim that one up-left into the next red bubble. Aim this red bubble down, then dash directly right and climb the wall. For the right key token, ride the second red bubble up-right and at the end dash directly right to reach the right red bubble. Aim this one at the key token and hold onto the wall after collecting it until the red bubble respawns, after which you should ride it back left. Try to fall inside the initial gap, using a direct upward dash to reposition yourself if you need to. Then go right from the starting area and claim the strawberry.

Above the left side of the first room is a hidden gap to another room. In this room, go to the red bubble and take it right to grab the strawberry, then quickly dash straight down. Steer yourself slightly left and take the bottom red bubble left before dashing up to get to safety.

In the second room, a transition can be seen in the middle of the room on the floor. Stand on the swap block in this room, then dash and move right to launch yourself to the wall and climb it to reach the strawberry.

By going to the left side of the second room above the entrance, you can find an area with some spinners and a swap block. Dash to this swap block, hold onto it, and then jump up the corridor when you arrive at it. In the room you arrive in, go to the top left. To get the winged strawberry in the next room, ride up the first two red bubbles to the ceiling then move left during your descent to reach the next one. For the third one, ride it left and make your way up the left area before dashing diagonally into the Winged Strawberry. Dash right as you fall, and you can easily make it out by riding the red bubbles up and dashing between them.

In the ceiling of the second room near the right, you can find a gap to the upper room. It may be tricky, but you need to jump right from the ledge and dash right to hold onto the swap block and let go right as the other swap block returns to the left. From there, jump right and dash diagonally up-right to get above where the third swap block was, and climb up to where the strawberry hovers.
Through another gap in the ceiling to the left of the one from the previous berry, this strawberry is accessed.

By going to the top-left of the fourth room, there's a transition to another berry room. Jump and dash diagonally up-left to get to the red bubble and ride it left. Go to the next red bubble up-right and keep moving right after collecting the strawberry. Dash into the next red bubble and take it right, then dash down before hitting the spinners.

By going to the top-right of the fourth room, another transition is found to a berry room. Ride the red bubble at the start to the right and, before hitting the spinners, dash diagonally up-right and grab the wall and the dash refill. Jump off the wall and dash again diagonally up-right, then climb this wall to reach the other red bubble. Direct it to the left and dash diagonally up-left before reaching the spinners. Land in the small gap on the floor where there are no spinners, and get back to the entrance.

At the bottom of the fourth room is a transition at the left side. Dash in place to activate the swap blocks and then quickly run to the left to fall into the gap in the floor. Jump to the left out of this gap when the swap blocks return to normal. Hold onto the swap block and dash to get the momentum to jump off and land where the strawberry is.

By going to the right of the bottom of the fourth room, there are 2 gaps in the floor which both lead to the same room which has a berry. Walk off the platform and move towards the center to grab the middle wall. Jump above the wall to the other side and grab the wall again. Jump off the wall and dash into a red bubble to take you back to the start of the room.

Go 2 rooms right off the bottom of the fourth room and from there the top-right transition leads to a strawberry. To reach it, dash to where the lower swap block is going to be and jump over the spinner as the swap block moves back. Do this again for the next swap block and then dash up on the right side to get to the transition.

Complete the steps for the previous berry but instead of heading for the top-left transition, go for the dash switch on the ceiling above the second swap block. This opens the temple gate on the right which leads to a seeded strawberry. Dash directly up into the leftmost seed and climb up the wall. Then, jump off the wall. climb the swap block, and jump above it to both grab the next seed and land on the spring. Then either move right from the spring and dash to the wall to climb to the last seed or boost yourself to the right by dashing from the swap block. In the lower right hand corner of this area, a transition to the area with the cassette can be found by dashing into the cracked wall.
Found in the sixth room, you'll need to lure the Seeker into the red wall on the right to break it and expose this strawberry and a spring.

Found in the third room is a section opposite the left key path located by going below the initial entrance. Dash left into the red bubble and ride it left a bit, then dash directly up. Hold onto the wall or swap block, then land on top of the swap block. Next, dash diagonally up-left to where the other swap block will arrive and land on it, then crouch until it returns to the left. When you uncrouch, you'll collect this strawberry. To make it back, dash directly up in this tiny corridor and fall to the red bubble, then take it back right.

Go to the top-left transition of the second room to find a secret room. Fall down and dash right into the red bubble, then take it left. When you're in the middle of both swap blocks, dash to the left out of the red bubble. Then you can find a section above the third room with this strawberry above a disappearing platform. Important note, this passage is only enterable once, so make sure you get the berry the first time you get to it, or you'll need to restart.

In the room right of the second room, go to the bottom right and there will be a secret gap in the spikes which leads to another room containing a berry. You'll need to distract the Seeker in the lower area to allow yourself to hop between the tiny safe bits of the ground and arrive at the strawberry, then do the same back to the beginning.

At the same section leading to the last berry, hold onto the swap block and dash to launch yourself to another swap block. Jump off this swap block into the dash refill and then dash diagonally up-right into the other swap block and climb up to the section above. The path reached leads right to the strawberry.

There is a strawberry seen by the red bubble on the right of the second room which would take you across the spikes much further left. Under the red bubble is a smashable wall, but it can only be destroyed by aiming this red bubble downward, which gives access to the strawberry.

By collecting all 3 keys, crossing the gap in the third room (meaning you would have 1 key while entering the red bubble), and going down to the next room, the key you have can be used to unlock a lock guarding this strawberry. Alternatively, you can have 1 key while skipping the bubble by doing an extended super.

Found in the sixth room, this strawberry requires strategic use of the Theo Crystal and the Seeker to reach. Get to the end of the room where the Strawberry is above and lure the Seeker over. Try to get a good bounce off of the Seeker and use the height to throw Theo into the dash switch on the wall inside spinners. This opens the temple gate blocking the berry, allowing you to freely dash up to it. Category:Mirror Temple Category:Chapters' collectables

In the third room, dash into a gap in the spinners to access the berry room. In it, you can grab the berry immediately, but then you have to navigate a room full of spinners to find a safe space to collect it.

In the fifth room, dash into the enclave in the ceiling at the end platform to find the room with two berries. For the left berry, dash up to a spring launching you into a wall, then use your 2 dashes to grab it and land back on the platform to collect it. For the right berry, dash up and walljump your way into a Dash Refill, then drop down to grab the berry and dash onto the starting platform to collect it.

In the fifth room, dash into the enclave in the ceiling at the end platform to find the room with two berries. For the left berry, dash up to a spring launching you into a wall, then use your 2 dashes to grab it and land back on the platform to collect it. For the right berry, dash up and walljump your way into a Dash Refill, then drop down to grab the berry and dash onto the starting platform to collect it.

In the sixth room, this strawberry is hovering above spinners, requiring you to dash above some platforms with spikes. Once you pick it up, complete the rest of the room (or return to its beginning) to collect it.

In the third room, this berry requires you to dash left after jumping off the zip mover and land on another one. Wait for it to return, then jump up to collect the berry and either return to the platform you started or continue on the alternate path.
This berry is found at the end of the first room in the alternate path. Ride the zippers up, then bounce on the spring to reach and collect this berry.

To the left of the sixth strawberry's location, a small bridge is seen on the left wall. Beyond it is a hidden passage to another room with this berry. After walking off the jump-through, dash left into the zip mover. Ride it up and fling Madeline upward, then dash left and reach the wall. Jump off the wall and ride the other zip mover to reach the wall, climb it, and collect the berry.

This winged berry is at the right of the fourth room on the main path. Use the spring to launch Madeline right and dash to go over the platform where the berry is, intercepting it while it is flying away.

In the eighth room, this Strawberry hovers around some falling platforms. Make the left block fall and then climb up the wall to grab this berry. Then, make the rightmost block fall and use the spring attached to it to reach the end of the room and collect the berry.
In the final (ninth) room, this berry is hiding beyond the Badeline Booster at the end. Skip it, then climb the walls on the right until you find a hole that leads to the area with this berry.

This berry is located to the left of the fourth room. To collect it, use two Dream Blocks to grab the berry. To get back, dash into the first dash refill, then dash up and right twice to reach the second. Then, dash into the wall, dash up and left into the dream block, and use your dashes to get back to safe ground.
To the right of the fifth room, dash up diagonally through the Dream Block, grab the strawberry, then dash down diagonally to collect it.
This berry is behind the fake wall hidden on the left path. Dash directly right into the dream block adjacent to the right wall.

This strawberry is to the left of the seventh room. Dash to the left wall and do an up-right dash followed by an up-left dash to get up the dream blocks. Then fall down, avoiding some spikes, to reach and collect the berry.
In the eighth room, this strawberry is above the second dream block in a suspicious hidden area reached by dashing left over the spikes above.
This berry is found just after the final Badeline Booster in an oddly textured smashable wall.
This berry is found in the first room of 1500M. It requires difficult timing to dash past 3 Dust Bunnies on the way to this berry.
This berry is found in a hole in the third room between some Dust Bunnies. After falling down, use timing to navigate some more dust bunnies and a sinking platform to collect.

This strawberry is hidden below the Strawberry 18 room, accessible by falling into a hole between some Dust Bunnies. To collect it, activate four touch switches so a platform blocking the strawberry can move. A good way to do this is to activate the touch switches from left to right. It is important not to touch too many walls, as they all have Dust Triggers on them, which will make it impossible to touch the same wall twice. It is also important to conserve your dash and stamina when possible.

Found in the fifth room, this strawberry is in the middle at the bottom around many dust bunnies. Stand on the jumpthrough below, dash right into the berry, and then quickly dash left and grab the wall. Climb it to reach safety and claim the strawberry.
In the sixth room, this berry is near a circling dust bunny and the dash refill. Once you grab the berry, replenish your dashes with the dash refill. Then, complete the room to collect it.

This berry is found to the left of the eighth room. Dash up-left as soon as the first dust bunny moves towards the right. After collecting the first dash refill, dash up-left then straight up, where drifting to the left should allow you to make it past the second dust bunny, where you must collect another dash refill and dash past the dust bunny, into the strawberry. Finally, use the spring to launch yourself back to the starting platform.

This berry is found beneath a smashable wall at the end of the eighth room. To collect it, drop down from the starting platform, dash right, then dash up. Repeat this, collect the berry, then immediately dash up to hit the spring. Dash left twice to get back to the starting platform.

In the tenth room, there is a gap in the ceiling leading to the room with this winged berry. To collect it, use the springs while avoiding the Dust Bunnies. At the end, dash to the final spring, then twice more to get to the room where you can intercept and collect this berry.

Above the second room, a small gap in the ceiling is seen on the left side. By going into the left screen transition and dashing up back to the second room, you can get into this gap. In it is a room filled with some pink clouds and spinners. Jump right after you land on the pink clouds to not be bounced into the spinners and you can easily make it to the end of this room where the strawberry floats.

Found in the fifth room, this strawberry floats at the far-right side below the ending bridge. To get to it, get to the left ledge just below and dash straight right, then straight up and hold onto the wall. Climb high and wait for a snowball to come at you, then jump onto it or let it hit you from below and then dash straight right twice to climb the right wall and collect this berry.

Found in the seventh room, this is one of the trickiest berries to collect in the game. Ride the triggered platform up for a bit and then after passing the crumble block, you'll need to precisely stall in the air and eventually dash into the dash refill at the same time the triggered platform is there. Jump off and then dash straight up into the strawberry, then repeat this process again when the triggered platform arrives. Finally, you'll need to do a dash straight up and then straight to the right to land back on the triggered platform and, by finishing the room, collect the strawberry.

In the eighth room, you can go to the left transition to find a room with this winged strawberry. By jumping from the right ledge, you can make it the left floating platform. Jump to the right and climb to the top of the right floating platform before jumping all the way to the left. With a straight left dash, then a quick straight up dash, you can catch the Winged strawberry before it flies away.

In the room of the previous strawberry, a smashable wall is seen on the ceiling which leads to another room with a strawberry. However, this is strawberry 6, not 5. Above the room is yet another secret berry room, accessed by leading the guided platform at the start to the left and riding it to the top transition of the screen. The room that follows is a seeded strawberry challenge. Like seen in Chapter 4's seeded strawberry, once you collect a seed the wind will start to blow to the left. Go to the top-right of the screen and dash into the nearby seed. Fall down into the dash refill, where you'll then diagonally dash up-left and jump constantly up the wall (to save stamina) and at the top, move right to collect the next seed. Jump off this wall and onto the right side of the floating platform, then jump over it and go to the left to climb the left wall into the final seed.

This berry is located below the room of the previous strawberry, as well as above the room of strawberry 4. In this room you need to first approach the guided platform by doing a straight-up dash and then a straight-right dash. Guide this guided platform to the right as it goes up and fall into the green bubble. Direct that green bubble up-right and then a straight up and straight right dash can get you to the other green bubble. For this one, launch it straight upward and then fall down and dash right in the gap of the spinners to reach the berry.

Found in the ninth room, this strawberry will be very straightforward to collect. As you're being carried to the right by the wind, you can see this strawberry in a small gap of spinners, so dash straight into it and then up-right to get into the green bubble and complete the room normally from there.

Found in the eleventh room, this strawberry has a familiar method of reaching it as some prior subchapters. At the end of the room where the Badeline booster would take you to the next subchapter, avoid the purple orb and dash to the right underneath it into the suspicious cracked wall with no spinners on it. Hidden in this area is a strawberry.

By riding the first red bubble left (or just dashing into the smashable wall it breaks), you can reach a room with this strawberry. Stand on the bridge above and dash onto the floor, then quickly run off the bridge and land in the red bubble. Take it left and, as soon as you reach the wall, jump right and grab the swap block. Let go right as it arrives back on the top and you'll be flung into the air. With both of your dashes in the section above, you can dash to the left and get the berry, then dash back to the right and claim it.

Found in the first room, this strawberry is located in the middle of the room under the usual red bubble path. Dash straight down into the gap of the spikes when passing it in the red bubble, then dash diagonally up-right to land on the disappearing platform. Jump up and do an upward, then diagonally up-right dash out of the area to another disappearing platform, then dash to get into the nearby red bubble.

This berry is found in the same room as the key above the fifth room, just on the left side instead of the right. Take the red bubble path two rooms below on the left to get to the strawberry's location.

At the start of the sixth room, ride the first red bubble straight up to reveal a hidden path above. This strawberry is found at the end of the first room you enter above a disappearing platform. First, you should make your way to the spring on the right and try to grab the wall above it. When the swap block is about halfway back to its original position, bounce on the spring and hold onto the swap block. From there, you can dash to the berry.

After finishing the room of the previous strawberry's location, two more rooms have to be completed. For the first room, carefully time jumping and dashing up into dash switches while avoiding blades, then do it again with springs. The strawberry is located in the second room after. The first challenge in the room just has you dashing on a swap block and launching yourself forward by jumping right after. Then, you'll need some careful dash timing around some blades.

Found in the twelfth room, this strawberry is located in a hidden area near the middle of the room. Below the swap block which is meant to launch you up to the last two swap blocks, a hidden passage is revealed by entering from the left side.

Right by the red bubble which you ride up into the purple orb, a few secret areas are located. To the top-left of the red booster, a dash switch is found. To the top-right of the red booster, a temple gate that opens from that dash switch is seen and it protects another dash switch. To the bottom-right of the red bubble, this strawberry is found behind a temple gate which the top-right dash switch unlocks.
To the bottom-left of the red bubble at the end of the twelfth room, the wall will reveal a hidden section with this strawberry.

Amid flag 26's platforming, this strawberry can be seen floating under a platform. To get it, simply dash right into it and then straight up and touch the close-by dash refill to continue onward and claim it.

At the end of flag 24, a strawberry is seen to the left of where flag 23 would be entered. From the crumble block below, jump to the left and dash leftward, then start to climb the wall. At the top of the wall, do a jump to the right to get the strawberry and get over the spikes, then dash right to land on the crumble block, then get to safety.

Near the start of flag 21, this berry is seen above the normal path around some spikes. Bounce off the spring and dash straight up to climb up the right side of the thin floating platform. Jump and dash into the strawberry, then jump back left. Finally, jump over the floating platform and keep going left to make it back to the flag.

To the left of flag 18, there is a section with a lot of spinners and this strawberry. To reach the berry, do a full bounce up from the cloud nearby and move left, over the spinners. Using your two dashes, carefully time boosting yourself up and reaching the strawberry while not touching the spinners. Afterward, fall into the dash refill and make your way back to the cloud.

There's a strawberry hovering to the bottom-right of flag 16. Do a diagonal dash into the strawberry after falling down from the bridge, then diagonally dash the other direction and wrap Madeline around the thin section of the wall to grab onto the left side and climb back up to safety.

To the left of flag 15, beyond the tall wall of spinners, this berry is floating near the left wall. Do a full jump and then dash diagonally up-left over the spinners to make it to the strawberry, then climb the wall and dash diagonally up-right back over the spinners.

This strawberry is hovering above the main path of flag 4, but it's recommended to make it to flag 3 as a breather point before going for this berry. A feather is needed to get to the area where this strawberry is. If going for this berry while completing flag 4, the feather utilized there can be brought upward to allow you to reach the small disappearing platform; if going for the berry after saving at flag 3, the feather found right above can be brought down and to the left to give you access to the area. Jump up on the small disappearing platform, dash diagonally up-left over the block of spinners, and grab the left side of the floating platform. From there, you can just jump to the disappearing platforms to the left and reach the strawberry, then ride the feather below onward normally and you can claim the strawberry when you land. Category:Chapters' collectables

To the left of the fifth room is a room with this strawberry seen floating far to the left near some fireballs. This strawberry is completely out of reach while the room is hot (though it can technically be obtained with a precise skip) so you'll need to turn the Core to cold and then go back here. The hot bumper above the starting area will have turned into a bumper which can be dashed into diagonally up-right to bounce you over to the ice balls over to the left. Bounce on these carefully to collect the strawberry, then make your way back right and use your other dash to make it back.

At the end of the first room, a transition at the top of the right side can be seen, blocked by a magma barrier. To get past this, continue onward into the next room until you reach the hot/cold switch, then hit it and bounce back to the left on the created ice balls. Make it back to the first room of the subchapter, then dash up to the vertical transition. In the following room, many bumpers are seen above a spike floor and corridors above them are surrounded by ice walls. This strawberry is in the farthest right of these ice wall corridors. There is a plethora of ways to approach this berry, but the most reliable way is to wall jump off of the floating platform's ice walls to get over to the bumper area without using a dash, then use both of your dashes to reach the strawberry. You can also barely reach this area by bouncing on the rightmost bumper and wall jumping. From there, bounce on the top-left side of the right bumper and move over to the left safely, returning to the start with either the wall jumping from earlier or a risky bounce on the left side of the leftmost bumper.

Found in the third room, you can find this berry at the end of the room floating at the top. After being bounced by the last bumper in the room, you should be in range to dash straight up into the strawberry and collect it.

This strawberry is located above the fourth room, which can be accessed in a small hole not far to the left of the hot/cold switch. It's easily enterable when the room is cold, but this will block off the strawberry with an ice barrier, forcing you to go left and restart the prior room. The actual way to get this berry won't be so simple, as you need to enter the room while it's hot. Bounce on some ice balls near the hot/cold switch while still having both dashes available to get up to it and change the room to hot. Then, start moving to the left with dashes and stalling properly until there's an opening to get up around any potential fireballs. After that, the berry is there to be collected and you can head to the right to fall to the end of the lower room.

Found in the seventh room, you can find this final strawberry hovering to the right of the last launching block of the room. This berry seems very tough to approach as normally you'd either run out of time or stamina and fall into the magma below. There's one key thing you need to do to get this berry easily, though. After being flung from the launching block on the left, use your other dash to get to where the strawberry floats, and then wall jump up. DON'T hold the climb button when doing this, or else you'll activate the launching block. Instead, just wall jump back and forth and jump above the top of the launching block so you can grab the left side and finish the room, claiming the strawberry. Category:Chapters' collectables Category:Core
